questionText: [Set 47.18] Which of the following is an inherent limitation of the planning function in modern dynamic business environments?

options.text: Planning eliminates all financial and operational risks automatically
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: Planning leads to rigidity and may not work effectively in a turbulent, fast-changing environment
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately solves the problem for Planning Premises and Limitations.

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
For Planning Premises and Limitations (Controlling):
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Bst (Planning - Planning Premises and Limitations):
Limitations of planning include: (1) Planning leads to rigidity, (2) Planning may not work in a dynamic environment, (3) It reduces individual creativity, (4) It involves huge costs and time consumption, (5) It does not guarantee success.

Hence, Option (C) is the correct answer.

Therefore, option (B) is the correct answer.
